**Coaching Note (78 words):**
Your queen was hanging on e3, attacked by White's queen on f2. Instead of defending passively or trading immediately, look for a forcing sequence with checks and captures. Nxf3+ gives check AND wins a pawn. After Kg2, you play Qxf2+ (check), forcing Kxf2, and you've won both a pawn and traded queens favorably. The lesson: **chains of forcing moves (checks and captures) often win more material than single moves. Always calculate two or three moves ahead.**
